The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 9.10 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It exceeds the threshold, so the amount is issued but not executed: it is held for release and the case is placed in the human queue.

The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties. Trip TRP-02804 (27 Aug 2026, Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres to Blk 25 Ghim Moh Link), charged SGD 45.82. 1) Deviation. On the governing GPS trace (EV-GPS-02804, weight 1.0) the driven route measures 29.13 km against the booked optimal of 22.1 km (EV-TRIP-02804). POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure, not the rounded trip-record copy. Excess = 7.03 km, 31.8%. That clears both establishment gates (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so the deviation is established; but it fails both materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%), so it is not a material deviation. The repeat-deviation check is therefore not engaged, and in any event EV-DPROF-02804 shows deviation_flags_90d = 1 against 329 completed trips, far below POL-RD-06's tests, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Both advocates agree on this, and I accept it. 2) The driver's traffic excuse. The driver says traffic was heavy so he took another road. POL-RD-13 tests that assertion against the trip's traffic advisory, and the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02804-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run. The driver's own statement names no evidence ID for any advisory; under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, and the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction. The driver's brief argues that because the driver 'cites' the missing identifier the case must escalate. I reject that: the citation to EV-ADVIS-02804-01 appears only in the advocate's argument, not in the driver's own assertion, and POL-RD-13(1) turns on the asserting party's own naming of an evidence ID. The traffic excuse accordingly carries no weight under POL-RD-08, the deviation stands at the measured figure, and the case does not escalate. 3) Other exculpatory routes are closed. POL-RD-04 cannot run (EV-CHAT-02804 holds 0 messages, so no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint). POL-RD-05 cannot run (no amendment timestamps; amended_optimal_distance_km is null). POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL). 4) No escalation trigger fires. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (100% coverage, 229 fixes at a 10 s interval, max_gap_sec 0.0), so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged; trip identifiers and timestamps agree; the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 and charged-total ceilings; and every fare line has a counterpart on the trace or trip record. 5) The refund. fare_model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 22.1 + 0.28 x 29.8) x 1.2 (surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.50 on-optimal-route ERP = 36.7628. Refund = charged_total 45.82 - 36.7628 = 9.0572, rounded UP to SGD 9.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 19.8% of the amount charged, below the 90% share that would make it a full refund, so the outcome is a partial refund of SGD 9.10. (The rider contested SGD 8.50; the arithmetic yields SGD 9.10.) 6) ERP. The single SGD 1.50 charge for PIE Eunos westbound is on the optimal route and matched to the trace (nearest fix 35.3 m, inside the 250 m crossing radius), so there is no billing-integrity finding and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. Under POL-RD-09(1) it is already comprehended in the recomputed fare and is not added on top. Confidence: every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02804, EV-TRIP-02804, EV-FARE-02804) is at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. Confidence is 0.95. Execution: the monetary effect of SGD 9.10 exceeds the POL-GEN-05 threshold of SGD 8.00, so the ruling issues but the amount is held for release by a human reviewer. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs and trip_record.actual_distance_km (29.1 km), the rounded convenience copy of the same measurement, may not be cited for the threshold test.

Limb (b): the excess of 7.03 km / 31.81% is measured from a gps_trace that is unimpaired, and it meets the POL-RD-01 threshold.

discarded The absent advisory does not convert this case into an escalation. The driver advocate

kept The deviation is established but it is not MATERIAL, and the difference matters for the remedy. On the governing trace figure of 29.13 km — POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern over trip_record.actual_distance_km, which is a rounded convenience copy and may not be cited for the threshold test — the excess over the 22.1 km optimal route is 7.03 km or 31.8% (both fields are COMPLETE, weight 1.0). That clears the establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20%, but it falls short of both materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50%. This is therefore an ordinary established deviation, not a material one, and the material-deviation consequences in POL-RD-06 are not engaged on this record.

evidence EV-GPS-02804, EV-TRIP-02804 · clauses POL-RD-01, POL-RD-06

kept No repeat-deviation pattern can be established against this driver. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the threshold of 3 that POL-RD-06 sets, and 1 flag across driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 329 is a ratio of 0.003, far below the 0.05 ratio the clause requires even where the 40-trip floor is met. It follows that neither the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) nor the conduct referral in POL-RD-06(c) is available to the rider, and POL-GEN-01 confines this test to those two named fields: prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is not the trailing-90-day figure the clause asks for.

evidence EV-DPROF-02804 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

kept The SGD 1.50 ERP line is properly chargeable and cannot be refunded or added on top of anything. The off-route ERP total is SGD 0.00, and because the POL-RD-02 recomputation already includes only the gantries on the optimal route, POL-RD-09(1) forbids counting this charge a second time.

evidence EV-GPS-02804, EV-FARE-02804 · clauses POL-RD-09, POL-RD-02

kept The driver's explanation — that traffic was heavy so he took another road — is an assertion of an external traffic cause, and POL-RD-13 requires such an assertion to be tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory artifact in this bundle is EV-ADVIS-02804-01, which is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run at all. Because the driver cites that missing identifier, POL-RD-03 is an exculpatory clause invoked against an artifact missing from the pool, which POL-RD-10(5) makes a mandatory escalation trigger; POL-RD-13(1) states in terms that it does not narrow POL-RD-10(5) where the party does cite the missing identifier, and that case still escalates. The cause of the detour is untestable on this record, so no monetary outcome should issue and the disputed amount should be held for a human reviewer.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02804-01, EV-GPS-02804 · clauses POL-RD-10, POL-RD-13, POL-RD-03

That is 19.8% of the amount charged, far below the 90% share that would convert the award into a FULL_REFUND, and above the SGD 0.50 de minimis. The outcome on the quantum is therefore a partial refund capped at SGD 9.10.

To both parties. Trip TRP-02804 (27 Aug 2026, Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres to Blk 25 Ghim Moh Link), charged SGD 45.82. 1) Deviation. On the governing GPS trace (EV-GPS-02804, weight 1.0) the driven route measures 29.13 km against the booked optimal of 22.1 km (EV-TRIP-02804). POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure, not the rounded trip-record copy. Excess = 7.03 km, 31.8%. That clears both establishment gates (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so the deviation is established; but it fails both materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%), so it is not a material deviation. The repeat-deviation check is therefore not engaged, and in any event EV-DPROF-02804 shows deviation_flags_90d = 1 against 329 completed trips, far below POL-RD-06's tests, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Both advocates agree on this, and I accept it. 2) The driver's traffic excuse. The driver says traffic was heavy so he took another road. POL-RD-13 tests that assertion against the trip's traffic advisory, and the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02804-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run. The driver's own statement names no evidence ID for any advisory; under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, and the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction. The driver's brief argues that because the driver 'cites' the missing identifier the case must escalate. I reject that: the citation to EV-ADVIS-02804-01 appears only in the advocate's argument, not in the driver's own assertion, and POL-RD-13(1) turns on the asserting party's own naming of an evidence ID. The traffic excuse accordingly carries no weight under POL-RD-08, the deviation stands at the measured figure, and the case does not escalate. 3) Other exculpatory routes are closed. POL-RD-04 cannot run (EV-CHAT-02804 holds 0 messages, so no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint). POL-RD-05 cannot run (no amendment timestamps; amended_optimal_distance_km is null). POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL). 4) No escalation trigger fires. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (100% coverage, 229 fixes at a 10 s interval, max_gap_sec 0.0), so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged; trip identifiers and timestamps agree; the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 and charged-total ceilings; and every fare line has a counterpart on the trace or trip record. 5) The refund. fare_model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 22.1 + 0.28 x 29.8) x 1.2 (surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.50 on-optimal-route ERP = 36.7628. Refund = charged_total 45.82 - 36.7628 = 9.0572, rounded UP to SGD 9.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 19.8% of the amount charged, below the 90% share that would make it a full refund, so the outcome is a partial refund of SGD 9.10. (The rider contested SGD 8.50; the arithmetic yields SGD 9.10.) 6) ERP. The single SGD 1.50 charge for PIE Eunos westbound is on the optimal route and matched to the trace (nearest fix 35.3 m, inside the 250 m crossing radius), so there is no billing-integrity finding and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. Under POL-RD-09(1) it is already comprehended in the recomputed fare and is not added on top. Confidence: every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02804, EV-TRIP-02804, EV-FARE-02804) is at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. Confidence is 0.95. Execution: the monetary effect of SGD 9.10 exceeds the POL-GEN-05 threshold of SGD 8.00, so the ruling issues but the amount is held for release by a human reviewer. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
Decision for both parties on trip TRP-02804. THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED, BUT NOT MATERIAL. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02804, weight 1.0, COMPLETE): its polyline runs 29.13 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off against a booked optimal of 22.1 km (EV-TRIP-02804) — an excess of 7.03 km, or 31.81%. Both POL-RD-01 gates (more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.8 km) pass, so a route deviation exists. The trip record's 29.1 km is the rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and was not used for the threshold test. Both figures fall short of the materiality gates (8.0 km, 50%), so the deviation is not MATERIAL and POL-RD-06 is not engaged for this trip: no full-refund uplift and no driver-conduct referral. The driver profile's deviation_flags_90d of 1 against completed_trips_90d of 329 is below both of that clause's tests, and it is the only use either profile is put to — rating, lifetime counters such as prior_deviation_flags, and the rider's other fields are context only under POL-GEN-01. The rider's deviation_claims_60d of 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 0 mean POL-RD-08's second-stage corroboration condition is not triggered. NO EXCUSE IS MADE OUT. The driver's explanation — that traffic was heavy and he took another road — cites no evidence ID. POL-RD-08 gives an uncited traffic assertion no weight, and POL-RD-13 tests such an assertion against this trip's traffic advisory and nothing else. The bundle holds none: EV-ADVIS-02804-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) and can carry no fact, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion is discarded. The contrary argument that the absent advisory makes this a mandatory escalation under POL-RD-10(5) is rejected: POL-RD-13(1) applies precisely because the driver named no advisory identifier, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-13(2) directs the deviation to stand at the measured figure. The remaining exculpatory routes are closed on the record: POL-RD-04 cannot run (EV-CHAT-02804 holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction, waypoint or timestamp to corroborate), POL-RD-05 cannot run (no amendment; amended_optimal_distance_km is null), and POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL). The trace itself is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c): 100.0% coverage, 229 fixes at a 10.0 s interval against an expected 10.0 s, max_gap_sec 0.0 and no gaps — so no independent-corroboration burden and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arise. THE MONEY. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs on the booked optimal route. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 22.1 + 0.28 x 29.8) x 1.2 (the surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02804.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.50 on-optimal-route ERP = 36.7628. Charged total 45.82 - 36.7628 = 9.0572, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 9.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and about 19.8% of the amount charged, far below the 90% share that would convert the award into a full refund, so the outcome is a partial refund. The single ERP line (PIE Eunos westbound, SGD 1.50) lies on the optimal route and its nearest trace fix is 35.3 m away, well inside the 250 m crossing radius: it is properly chargeable, itemised here for transparency, already comprehended in the recomputation, and not added on top of it (POL-RD-09(1)). There is no phantom gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge, so there is no billing-integrity failure and no billing referral. No driver compensation arises: the billed distance (29.1 km) is short of the trace distance (29.13 km) by only 0.03 km, far below the 1.0 km shortfall POL-RD-04 requires. OUTCOME. PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.10 to the rider, no driver compensation, no referrals. Because the monetary effect exceeds the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, the amount is issued but held for release by a human reviewer under POL-GEN-05 rather than executed on issue. Either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04. Confidence rests on artifacts at weight 1.0 (GPS trace, trip record, fare breakdown); no artifact below weight 1.0 carries any deciding fact.
Rider and driver: this is trip TRP-02804 (Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres to Blk 25 Ghim Moh Link, 27 Aug 2026). The route deviated and part of the fare is returned to the rider. WHAT IS DECIDED. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02804, COMPLETE, weight 1.0) measures 29.13 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff; the booked optimal route (EV-TRIP-02804) is 22.1 km. Excess is 7.03 km, 31.81% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs and the trip record's rounded 29.1 km may not be cited for the threshold test. Both gates are cleared (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so the deviation is established on this trip's own evidence; it is NOT material (7.03 km is below 8.0 km and 31.81% is below 50%), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered and no conduct referral arises. In any event the profile shows 1 deviation flag in 90 days against 329 completed trips, far below the clause's tests, and POL-GEN-01 confines that test to those two fields. THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver says traffic was heavy so he took another road. That is a general assertion that names no evidence, and no traffic advisory is on file for this trip: EV-ADVIS-02804-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). Under POL-RD-08 an uncited traffic assertion carries no weight, and under POL-RD-13 POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion neither reduces the excess nor supplies an adjusted optimal route. The suggestion that the missing advisory obliges me to escalate is rejected: the asserting party (the driver) named no advisory, so the absent artifact is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact (POL-RD-13(1)); the deviation therefore stands at the measured figure and the arithmetic below runs against the booked optimal route (POL-RD-13(2)). The other driver-side defences are closed on the record: the chat log has 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour can be shown (POL-RD-04); pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so no relocation re-quote exists (POL-RD-05); and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so the pooled-trip baseline does not apply (POL-RD-12). THE MONEY. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 applies: (3.80 base + 0.75 x 22.1 km + 0.28 x 29.8 min) x 1.2 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier + 0.80 platform fee + 1.50 ERP on the optimal route = 36.7628 recomputed fare. Charged_total is 45.82, so the refund is 45.82 - 36.7628 = 9.0572, rounded up to SGD 9.10 — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 19.8% of the charge, well short of the 90% that would make it a full refund. That figure is fixed by the fare lines, not by the sum claimed, and it covers the SGD 8.50 contested in full. The single ERP line (PIE Eunos westbound, SGD 1.50) lies on the optimal route and is matched to the trace, the nearest fix passing 35.3 m away (inside the 250 m radius), so it is properly chargeable, is already comprehended in the recomputation, and is not refunded separately or added on top (POL-RD-09(1)); there is no billing-integrity failure and no referral on that ground. No driver compensation is due: the fare billed 29.1 km against the trace's 29.13 km, a 0.03 km shortfall, far below the 1.0 km the clause requires (POL-RD-04). The rider's 60-day claim counts are 0, so POL-RD-08 adds no extra corroboration requirement. CONFIDENCE AND NEXT STEPS. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes (100% coverage, 229 fixes at a 10 s interval, longest gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) do not apply, and no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The ruling rests on artifacts all at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.9. Because the refund of SGD 9.10 exceeds the execution threshold of SGD 8.00, this provisional ruling issues but is not executed automatically: the amount is held and the case goes to the human queue for release (POL-GEN-05). Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
